requirements.name: One outbox event is recorded per meaningful lifecycle transition

scenarios.name: Creating a notification records a creation event

tests.test: writes a NotificationCreated event immediately on draft creation
tests.notes: Mongo outbox; notificationStatusCode DRAFT and statusChanges DRAFT

scenarios.name: Submitting a notification records a submission event carrying the submitted detail

tests.test: records a NotificationSubmitted outbox event on UI submission
tests.notes: SUBMITTED status, consignment fields, and authenticated actor identity

scenarios.name: Starting and cancelling an amendment each record their own event

tests.test: records the authenticated actor and cumulative status changes on amendment
writes a NotificationAmendmentCancelled event when an amendment is cancelled
tests.notes: joint: cancelled event with SUBMITTED status and statusChanges through AMEND back to SUBMITTED

scenarios.name: Soft-deleting a draft and soft-deleting a submitted notification record different events

tests.test: writes a NotificationDeleted event when a draft is soft-deleted
writes a NotificationSubmissionDeleted event when a submitted notification is soft-deleted

requirements.name: Deleting a never-submitted draft records no withdrawal event

scenarios.name: Deleting a draft that was never submitted records no separate withdrawal event

tests.test: does not write a withdrawn event when a draft is deleted
tests.notes: asserts zero NotificationWithdrawn documents for the aggregate

requirements.name: Every event references the notification's scanned accompanying documents, coded by type

scenarios.name: A submitted notification references each scanned document with its type code and codelist

tests.test: references a scanned accompanying document on the NotificationSubmitted event, coded from the document-type codelist
tests.notes: real upload and virus scan, then the Mongo outbox entry: typeCode 853, the GBN-AG document-type codelist urlId, reference, date of issue
all fourteen document types pinned to their code, matching schemas/codelists/gbn-ag-document-types.json, and to the single codelist urlId

scenarios.name: A notification with no documents sends no document references

tests.test: records a NotificationSubmitted outbox event on UI submission
tests.notes: the journey uploads no document; asserts exchangedDocument has no referenceDocument property
stored payload map has no referenceDocument key

scenarios.name: A document still being scanned is not referenced

tests.notes: backend integration test against real Mongo (recorded as unit, the nearest type): one COMPLETE and one PENDING document saved, only the COMPLETE one on the submitted event
